summary: Provisional source review, not a security certification. Existing authorization grants are preserved and a least-privilege group-profile block is proposed locally. Real rules enforcement and deployed configuration remain unverified.

findings.issue: The emulator suite cannot start without its Java runtime and Firestore JAR. Browser contract checks use synthetic adapters, not the rules engine.
findings.recommendation: Restore the official emulator tools and pass the existing and extended deny/allow tests before a real pilot release.

findings.issue: The owner supplied the current published rules; the app now uses their membership-protected thread read without requiring direct membership reads. Provider linkage and memberships of the four real Auth accounts remain unverified. Extended test rules include grants absent from the published baseline.
findings.recommendation: Validate the owner-supplied baseline in the emulator, verify intended enrollments without logging private data, and obtain approval for any minimal profile extension. Do not publish the entire extended test fixture.

findings.issue: Display names are self-chosen, can be duplicated, and must not be treated as verified legal identities or an authorization source.
findings.recommendation: Use UID-bound ownership and group membership for every authorization decision; let pilot members choose recognizable names.
